description: '''Blog rock''' (also known as '''blog indie''') is a loosely defined style and era of [[indie rock]] that originally emerged from the [[Old Internet|online]] musical [[blogosphere]] in the mid-to late 2000s. Similarly to other early [[blog]]-related music scenes such as [[bloghouse]] and [[blog rap]]. The term was used to describe bands who garnered attention primarily through music blogs and online spaces, independent of formal music industry structures.
